decisive_items: heliotrope rash and erythematous lip swelling
positive myositis panel for anti-SAE antibodies
Skin biopsy results were consistent with Wong-type presentation
response.rationale: Dermatomyositis is most likely given the combination of classic skin findings (heliotrope rash), proximal muscle weakness, elevated creatine kinase, anti-SAE antibodies, and Wong-type dermatomyositis skin pathology.

rejected.why: Positive anti-SSA alone is nonspecific and does not establish Sjögren syndrome without sicca symptoms or characteristic glandular involvement; the clinical picture is dominated by DM features.
Polymyositis explains muscle weakness and elevated creatine kinase but cannot account for the distinctive skin findings, anti-SAE antibodies, and Wong-type biopsy.
